name: Growing Old
overview: Scripture honors the process of growing old as a sign of God's blessing and faithfulness, encouraging respect for the elderly as commanded in Exodus 20:12 and Leviticus 19:32. The gray head is portrayed as a crown of glory when accompanied by righteousness (Proverbs 16:31), reflecting a life lived in obedience to God’s commands (Deuteronomy 28:1). The beauty and dignity of old age are affirmed alongside the strength of youth (Proverbs 20:29), and the righteous are promised to flourish and grow strong like enduring trees (Psalms 92:12).
